verdict.rationale: Founder Law's own site has a pricing page that advertises flat-fee, all-inclusive packages, covering visa petitions with "absolute cost certainty" and dependents at a standardized flat rate. However, no actual dollar figures appear anywhere in the evidence, so it is unproven that a founder can see real prices before talking to anyone. missing for 10: actual published price amounts per package or service, a priced menu-of-services listing, independent confirmation that prices are visible without a consultation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site

citations.quote: Covers O-1A, H-1B, L-1, E-3, and TN petitions and transfers with absolute cost certainty.
Dependents such as a spouse or children are added to your primary legal package at a standardized, flat rate
We offer simple, all-inclusive packages that cover everything, including government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses.
